title: Dog Typing Spell Coffee
description: A brown and white dog with large ears sits at a desk between two vintage computers. Its front paws rest on a keyboard while a dismembered human foot with red nail polish lies on the desk in front of it. The left monitor displays the text 'Spelll coffee.' in orange letters.
prompt: A surreal scene of a brown and white dog with large pointed ears and a black collar sitting upright at a white desk, front paws on a vintage keyboard. To its left is a retro gray CRT monitor on a matching computer base displaying the misspelled text 'Spelll coffee.' in orange. To the right is a beige boxy computer with a damaged screen. A severed human foot with red painted toenails rests on the desk. Soft dramatic lighting, painterly style with visible brushstrokes.
